messages:
marta: FYI I hit a nasty TS inference regression when our SDK is bundled for Edge. Generic overloads stop inferring and callers see `any`. Minimal repro in a tiny sample app.

devon: ouch. paste the minimal example?

marta: gist: 
```ts
// lib.ts
export function run<T>(path: string, opts?: { body?: T }): Promise<{ out: T }>;
export function run(path: string, opts?: any) { /* impl */ }
```
When Vite -> esbuild builds targetting workers, `run<User>` becomes `any` at callsites. Node/CJS is fine.

sandeep: could be declaration emission or moduleResolution differences. What tsconfig + build are you using?

marta: tsconfig: module=esnext, moduleResolution=bundler, declaration=true, emitDeclarationOnly in build. Vite5 + esbuild targeting webworker. Repro both importing from src paths and from dist (compiled d.ts).

olivia: i've seen overload inference get lost when .d.ts are post-processed or flattened. Do you bundle d.ts or run a dts plugin?

marta: our pipeline bundles d.ts with a tool. importing from raw source keeps inference; importing from dist breaks.

devon: also check for `unknown` vs `any` in nearby types. `unknown` in impl or helpers can block inference through overloads.

marta: swapping some `unknown` to `any` in repro made things better, but we can't relax types in main SDK.

sandeep: recommendation: 1) avoid bundling/transforming d.ts; emit tsc `.d.ts` directly (declarationMap true) so overload shapes are preserved. 2) add a tiny platform adapter for fetch so return types are identical across Node/Edge (avoids unions like `Response | undefined`). 3) CI job: install built package into our small-app template, run Vite + typecheck to catch this.

olivia: also add a note in onboarding sample: prefer `moduleResolution: node16` or explicit path mapping until `bundler` stabilizes for consumers.

ci-bot: @marta opened issue #1260: "Edge bundle: generic overload inference lost due to d.ts packaging" https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1260 :gear:

marta: created repro repo and a short PR to change packaging to emit tsc d.ts only. I'll also add the fetch adapter and a small CI integration. Thanks for the quick triage. :rocket:
